cases.title: Default Initialization on Page Load
cases.description: Verify that upon loading the application, currency-one defaults to USD, currency-two defaults to EUR, amount-one defaults to 1, and the exchange rate and converted amount are fetched and displayed correctly.

cases.title: Currency One Selection and Dynamic Conversion
cases.description: Verify that selecting a new currency in 'currency-one' fetches the latest exchange rate, updates the 'exchange-rate' display format, and calculates the correct converted amount in 'amount-two'.

cases.title: Amount One Input Changes and Large Number Handling
cases.description: Verify that typing in 'amount-one' dynamically updates 'amount-two' rounded to two decimal places, handling normal inputs as well as edge cases like very large numbers.

cases.title: Currency Two Selection and Rate Update
cases.description: Verify that selecting a currency from 'currency-two' uses 'currency-one' as the base to fetch the latest rate, updates the exchange rate string, and recalculates 'amount-two'.

cases.title: Swap Button Functionality and Zero Amount Edge Case
cases.description: Verify that clicking the 'swap-button' exchanges the values of 'currency-one' and 'currency-two', triggers recalculation, and handles edge cases such as 'amount-one' being zero resulting in '0.00' for 'amount-two'.

cases.title: Same Currency Selection Edge Case
cases.description: Verify that when both 'currency-one' and 'currency-two' are set to the same currency, the exchange rate display correctly shows '1 [currency-one] = 1 [currency-two]'.

opinions.feedback: All proposed test cases are clear, distinct, cover all requirements properly, and contain no blockers.
All requirements and cases are well-aligned, consistent, and testable. No blockers identified.

analysis.analysis:
R-1: Testable behavior includes currency-one selection fetching API rates, updating 'exchange-rate' text to '1 [currency_one] = [currentRate] [currency_two]', and updating 'amount-two' based on 'amount-one' rounded to 2 decimals. Boundaries: dynamic changes to inputs and dropdowns. Normal path: valid currency selection and number input. Abnormal path/ambiguity: API failures not specified.

R-2: Testable behavior includes updating 'amount-two' dynamically on 'amount-one' input changes using API rates for 'currency-one' and 'currency-two'. Boundaries: very large numbers. Normal path: positive numeric input. Abnormal path/edge cases: zero or negative numbers, non-numeric characters.

R-3: Testable behavior includes selecting 'currency-two', fetching API rates with 'currency-one' as base, updating 'exchange-rate', and calculating 'amount-two' rounded to 2 decimals. Boundaries: currency-two matching or differing from currency-one. Normal path: valid selection. Abnormal path: API error handling.

R-5: Testable behavior includes swapping 'currency-one' and 'currency-two' values on 'swap-button' click, triggering rate recalculation, updating 'exchange-rate' and 'amount-two'. Boundaries: amount-one set to zero resulting in '0.00' for amount-two. Normal path: clicking swap with active values. Abnormal path: rapid successive clicks.

R-6: Testable behavior includes selecting two currencies, inputting amount-one, fetching API rates, displaying format '1 [currency-one] = [rate] [currency-two]', updating amount-two, and swapping. Boundaries: both selected currencies being the same displaying '1 [currency_one] = 1 [currency_two]'. Normal path: distinct currencies. Abnormal path: invalid API responses.

R-7: Testable behavior includes automatic initialization on page load, fetching USD to EUR exchange rates, setting currency-one to USD and currency-two to EUR, setting amount-one default to 1, and displaying formatted exchange rate and calculated amount-two. Boundaries: initial load state. Normal path: successful default API fetch. Abnormal path: API failure on load.

coverage.feedback: The accepted cases provide comprehensive coverage across all listed requirements (R-1, R-2, R-3, R-5, R-6, and R-7) without notable coverage gaps. There is minor conceptual overlap regarding the swap functionality and currency selection mechanisms between R-1, R-5, and R-6, but the test cases successfully partition these into distinct behaviors (such as specific edge cases like zero amounts and identical currency selections), keeping repetition minimal and well-targeted.
